== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]])<ref>Additional system and world details by [[User:Nichollsr1970|Roger Nicholls]]</ref> ==  
=== Stellar Data ===
'''Acton''' has a solitary primary star.
* It is a red main sequence named ''Endinho''.
* The star and its system are c.8.5Gyr in age.

{{MonostellarSystem
|name           = Acton
|primary        = M1 V 
|PrimaryName    = Endinho
|PrimaryNotes   = 
}}

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:

[[File:Chart Acton System Basic Large.jpg|800 px]]

* The [[mainworld]].
* x8 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]].
** Dan, an [[inferno world]] orbiting in the [[habitable zone]].
** Piojun, an [[ice world]] orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
** Natregun, a [[radworld]] orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
** Lotu, an [[ice world]] orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
** Rojunyen, an [[ice world]] orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
** Stasiki, a [[radworld]] orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
** Zan, an [[ice world]] orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
** Emma, a [[worldlet]] orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
* x2 [[planetoid belt]]s.
** The Irke Belt is a broad [[planetoid belt]] lying in the [[Outer World|outer system]]. It contains 5% metallic, 65% rocky/stony and 15% carbonaceous planetoids. In addition the remaining 15% of the planetoids are comprised of other poor mineral bodies.
** The Elye Belt is a broad [[planetoid belt]] lying in the [[Outer World|outer system]]. It contains 0% metallic, 1% rocky/stony and 85% carbonaceous planetoids. In addition the remaining 14% of the planetoids are comprised of other poor mineral bodies.
* x3 [[gas giant]]s.
** Trepen, is a large gas giant orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
** Nurtec, is a large gas giant orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
** Fillon, is a large gas giant orbiting in the [[Outer World|outer system]].

== History & Background (Dossier)<ref>Additional population and social details by [[User:Nichollsr1970|Roger Nicholls]]</ref> ==
[[File:Comp-Prog-Dav-R-Deitrick-Starter-Trav-Page-16 16-July-2018a.jpg|right]]
[[Solomani Security]] keeps a close eye on things to ensure the security of the [[Solomani Confederation|Solomani State]] and the well-being of its loyal citizens. Almost anyone ''could'' be a [[Solomani Security|SolSec]] informant, passing on all sorts of useful information: some gain a reward or benefit for their actions, others are coerced, while many see it as an act of duty to help protect the [[Solomani Confederation|the State]] and its interests.
